section_summary: This section chiefly records Japanese merchant-vessel movements between Japan, the Americas, Australia, Africa and Asian ports in May and June 1941. Many telegrams are followed by separate State Department paraphrases sent to the Navy. Other records concern ship supplies in the Philippines, Panama Canal transit figures, cargoes, crew lists and British blacklisting reports.

subfiles.title: SAGA MARU at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports the SAGA MARU's arrival, cargo discharge and planned departure.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived from Los Angeles, discharged 246 tons of Japanese cargo, and was due to sail for Balboa without taking on cargo or passengers.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of SAGA MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates the Manzanillo report on the SAGA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Records its cargo discharge and planned Balboa sailing.

subfiles.title: Japanese vessel sailings from Yokohama
subfiles.about: Reports sailings of four Japanese merchant vessels.
subfiles.summary: Lists NORFOLK, BOSTON, BELGIUM and NISSHO MARU with their destinations.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Yokohama sailings
subfiles.about: Restates the Yokohama sailing report.
subfiles.summary: Gives routes or destinations for four vessels.

subfiles.title: Panama Canal closing cross-reference
subfiles.to: Secretary and Under Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Points to a request concerning a report that the Panama Canal was closing to Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: References telegram 200 in file 811.812-Protection/265.

subfiles.title: MONTEVIDEO MARU sailing
subfiles.about: Reports the MONTEVIDEO MARU's departure for South America.
subfiles.summary: The ship sailed via Los Angeles and the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of MONTEVIDEO MARU sailing
subfiles.about: Restates the MONTEVIDEO MARU route.
subfiles.summary: Reports its May 26 departure.

subfiles.title: AWAZISAN MARU departure
subfiles.about: Reports a Japanese steamship leaving Buenos Aires.
subfiles.summary: The vessel departed for Yokohama via the Panama Canal and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: High Commissioner's forwarding endorsement
subfiles.from: Claude A. Buss, for the United States High Commissioner
subfiles.about: Forwards material connected with radiograms on control of supplies to Japanese ships.
subfiles.summary: Cites radiogram 188 and the Department's radiogram 173.

subfiles.title: Control of supplies to Japanese ships
subfiles.about: Examines possible control of fuel, water and coal supplied to Japanese vessels in the Philippines.
subfiles.summary: Bell consulted oil companies, stevedores, quarantine staff and naval officers. He found no abnormal Japanese vessel purchases and arranged monthly oil reports and prompt notices of suspicious orders. He believed voluntary limits on fuel, water and coal could be secured if needed.

subfiles.title: Weekly reports on Japanese shipping through the Panama Canal
subfiles.to: Assistant Chief of Staff, G-2, War Department
subfiles.about: Summarizes Japanese vessel transits and tonnage for two weeks in April.
subfiles.summary: Gives northbound and southbound totals and counts vessels in Atlantic areas.

subfiles.title: YAMAZATO, HEIAN and ANYO sailings
subfiles.about: Reports three Japanese vessel sailings.
subfiles.summary: Lists routes to South America, Seattle and Vancouver, and Bombay.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of May 27 sailings
subfiles.about: Restates the YAMAZATO, HEIAN and ANYO report.
subfiles.summary: Lists the three vessels' destinations.

subfiles.title: AFRICA arrival
subfiles.about: Reports the Japanese-flag vessel AFRICA arriving from Sumatra.
subfiles.summary: AFRICA arrived on May 30.

subfiles.title: Bills of health granted at Kobe
subfiles.about: Lists Japanese ships granted bills of health since May 13.
subfiles.summary: Names vessels bound for New York, the Canal Zone, Manila, Los Angeles and Seattle.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Kobe bills of health
subfiles.about: Restates the Kobe bills-of-health list.
subfiles.summary: Lists ships and their intended routes.

subfiles.title: TAIYO, TOKYO and DURBAN MARU sailings
subfiles.about: Reports May 28 sailings; its TOKYO MARU destination was later corrected.
subfiles.summary: Reports TAIYO for Manila and DURBAN for Calcutta; the corrected copy gives TOKYO for Melbourne.

subfiles.title: First Navy paraphrase of May 28 sailings
subfiles.about: Relays the initial version of the Yokohama sailing report.
subfiles.summary: This copy incorrectly places TOKYO MARU with DURBAN MARU for Calcutta.

subfiles.title: Revised Navy paraphrase of May 28 sailings
subfiles.about: Corrects TOKYO MARU's destination to Melbourne.
subfiles.summary: Also lists TAIYO for Manila and DURBAN for Calcutta.

subfiles.title: Damaged copy of May 28 sailing paraphrase
subfiles.about: Reproduces the corrected Yokohama sailing notice.
subfiles.summary: OCR is damaged, but Melbourne, Calcutta and Manila remain discernible.

subfiles.title: Corrected Yokohama telegram
subfiles.about: Corrects the May 28 vessel destinations.
subfiles.summary: TOKYO MARU is bound for Melbourne; DURBAN MARU for Calcutta and TAIYO MARU for Manila.

subfiles.title: DAITI OGURA MARU cross-reference
subfiles.about: Points to a telegram on the DAITI OGURA MARU's movements and cargo.
subfiles.summary: References telegram 753 in another file.

subfiles.title: SANUKI MARU cargo and departure
subfiles.about: Reports SANUKI MARU's Manzanillo call, cargo and passengers.
subfiles.summary: The vessel unloaded marble, loaded mercury, turpentine and fluorspar, and sailed for Japan via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of SANUKI MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates the SANUKI MARU's cargo exchange and sailing.
subfiles.summary: Reports its May 30 arrival and May 31 departure.

subfiles.title: KOEI arrival at Vancouver
subfiles.about: Reports the Japanese vessel KOEI arriving from Japan.
subfiles.summary: KOEI arrived at Vancouver on May 29.

subfiles.title: Copy of KOEI arrival telegram
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Vancouver arrival report.
subfiles.summary: Records KOEI's May 29 arrival.

subfiles.title: SEIA MARU at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports SEIA MARU's passage through Santos.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Rio de Janeiro on May 29 and sailed for Buenos Aires on May 30.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of SEIA MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates the Santos report on SEIA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Records arrival from Rio de Janeiro and departure for Buenos Aires.

subfiles.title: Late-May Yokohama departures
subfiles.about: Reports ONOE, SINKOKU, NITTA and MANZYU departures.
subfiles.summary: The page's opening is truncated; the accompanying paraphrase supplies ONOE's and SINKOKU's routes.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Yokohama departures
subfiles.about: Lists four vessels leaving Yokohama on May 29–30.
subfiles.summary: Gives destinations and routes for SINKOKU, ONOE, MANZYU and NITTA.

subfiles.title: YAMAGIRI MARU at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports YAMAGIRI MARU's arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived from Buenos Aires and sailed for Los Angeles via the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of YAMAGIRI MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates the YAMAGIRI MARU's Santos movements.
subfiles.summary: Records its May 28 arrival and June 2 departure.

subfiles.title: TAKA OKA MARU at Peru
subfiles.about: Reports TAKA OKA MARU's arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived June 1 from Mollendo and departed June 2 for Valparaíso via Mollendo.

subfiles.title: YAMAZUKI MARU at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports YAMAZUKI MARU's route through Santos.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Rio de Janeiro and sailed for Montevideo and Buenos Aires.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of YAMAZUKI MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates the Santos report on YAMAZUKI MARU.
subfiles.summary: Records its June 1 arrival and June 3 departure.

subfiles.title: NICHII arrival at Makatea
subfiles.about: Reports NICHII arriving at Makatea from Japan.
subfiles.summary: The arrival was reported on June 4.

subfiles.title: AWATA MARU cargo at Tampico
subfiles.about: Reports AWATA MARU's route and metal cargo.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived in ballast from New York and departed for Japan via the Canal and Los Angeles with lead, mercury and vanadium concentrates.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of AWATA MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates AWATA MARU's Tampico cargo and route.
subfiles.summary: Lists 3,048 tons of lead and 137 tons of mercury and vanadium concentrate.

subfiles.title: Notice to Los Angeles customs collector
subfiles.about: Alerts customs to export-controlled articles aboard AWATA MARU.
subfiles.summary: Identifies lead and mercury and vanadium concentrates in the vessel's cargo.

subfiles.title: Japanese sailings of May 31–June 2
subfiles.about: Reports routes of five departing vessels.
subfiles.summary: Lists RAKUYO, KANSAI, KIYOKAWA, AKIURA and a tentatively identified TOTTORI.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of May 31–June 2 sailings
subfiles.about: Restates the five-vessel sailing report.
subfiles.summary: Provides dates and destinations, retaining uncertainty about TOTTORI.

subfiles.title: SEIA MARU at Montevideo
subfiles.about: Reports SEIA MARU's arrival and onward route.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Buenos Aires and departed for Santos, Rio de Janeiro, the Canal, Los Angeles and Kobe.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Montevideo SEIA MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates SEIA MARU's Montevideo call.
subfiles.summary: Records its June 2 arrival and June 4 departure.

subfiles.title: Kobe bills of health since May 28
subfiles.about: Lists six Japanese ships granted bills of health.
subfiles.summary: Gives routes for KIYOKAWA, YAWATA, ONOE, HIKAWA, YAMAURA and KIYOSUMI.

subfiles.title: NORWAY MARU at Guayaquil
subfiles.about: Reports NORWAY MARU's arrival and expected departure.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Buenaventura and was expected to sail for Callao and points south.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of NORWAY MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates NORWAY MARU's Guayaquil movements.
subfiles.summary: Records its June 5 arrival and anticipated southbound sailing.

subfiles.title: ARABIA MARU at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports ARABIA MARU's arrival and intended route.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived from Rio de Janeiro and was sailing for Los Angeles via Bahia and the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of ARABIA MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates the Santos ARABIA MARU report.
subfiles.summary: Records the June 3 arrival and planned passage through Bahia and the Canal.

subfiles.title: SYOYO tanker sailing
subfiles.about: Reports SYOYO sailing for San Luis, California.
subfiles.summary: The tanker departed June 4; the OCR gives conflicting telegram dates.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of SYOYO sailing
subfiles.about: Restates SYOYO's June 4 departure.
subfiles.summary: The tanker was bound for San Luis, California.

subfiles.title: Crew lists for three Japanese ships
subfiles.about: Reports crew lists granted to TOA, NISSIN MARU No. 2 and KUROSIO.
subfiles.summary: Two ships were bound for Los Angeles and one for San Francisco.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of crew-list report
subfiles.about: Restates the three Osaka crew-list grants.
subfiles.summary: Lists the ships and California destinations.

subfiles.title: GINYO MARU at Buenaventura
subfiles.about: Reports GINYO MARU's Colombian call and southbound departure.
subfiles.summary: The vessel came from Japan via California, Central America and Balboa, then left for Peru and Chile.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of GINYO MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates GINYO MARU's route and departure.
subfiles.summary: Reports departure from Buenaventura on June 8.

subfiles.title: NICHII departure
subfiles.about: Reports NICHII sailing for Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: The departure was reported on June 8.

subfiles.title: TYOKO arrival at Sydney
subfiles.about: Reports a Japanese vessel identified as TYOKO arriving at Sydney.
subfiles.summary: It arrived June 9 from Mike.

subfiles.title: Copy of TYOKO arrival telegram
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Sydney arrival report.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the vessel name TYOKO and origin Mike.

subfiles.title: Request to verify Sydney vessel name
subfiles.about: Asks whether the Sydney arrival was TYOKO MARU or TOKYO MARU.
subfiles.summary: Requests verification of the vessel's name.

subfiles.title: NARUTO MARU cargo at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports NARUTO MARU's cargo exchange, passenger and planned departure.
subfiles.summary: The vessel discharged Japanese goods including medicines and permanganate, loaded cargo including dyes, and was due to sail for Balboa.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of NARUTO MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates NARUTO MARU's Manzanillo report.
subfiles.summary: Details discharged and loaded cargo, one transit passenger and planned Balboa sailing.

subfiles.title: NISSYO MARU tanker sailing
subfiles.about: Reports NISSYO MARU sailing for Long Beach.
subfiles.summary: The tanker departed June 6.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of NISSYO MARU sailing
subfiles.about: Restates the tanker's departure for Long Beach.
subfiles.summary: Records the June 6 sailing from Yokohama.

subfiles.title: YAMAZUKI MARU at Montevideo
subfiles.about: Reports YAMAZUKI MARU arriving and departing on June 7.
subfiles.summary: The telegram says it came from Cape Town and left for Buenos Aires.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Montevideo YAMAZUKI MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates YAMAZUKI MARU's same-day Montevideo call.
subfiles.summary: Reports arrival from Cape Town and departure for Buenos Aires.

subfiles.title: SAGAMI MARU at Buenaventura
subfiles.about: Reports SAGAMI MARU's arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Japan via California and Balboa and was leaving for Peru and Chile.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of SAGAMI MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates SAGAMI MARU's Buenaventura movements.
subfiles.summary: Records the June 11 arrival and planned departure that afternoon.

subfiles.title: SEIA MARU at Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports SEIA MARU's arrival and planned departure.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived June 5 and was due to leave for Los Angeles, Yokohama and Kobe via the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Buenos Aires SEIA MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates SEIA MARU's Buenos Aires schedule.
subfiles.summary: Records the June 5 arrival and expected June 11 sailing.

subfiles.title: TOLI MARU naval personnel and oil voyage
subfiles.from: Sokobin, Kobe, relayed by Lockhart, Shanghai
subfiles.about: Reports a Japanese tanker sailing from Kure to load oil in Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Its visaed crew list included 15 Japanese naval personnel in addition to 46 regular crew.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of TOLI MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates the TOLI MARU's voyage and crew composition.
subfiles.summary: Notes the report reached Shanghai through the purser of PRESIDENT CLEVELAND.

subfiles.title: British blacklisting of whaling ships and tankers
subfiles.from: Sokobin, Kobe, relayed by Lockhart, Shanghai
subfiles.about: Reports press accounts of a British Consulate blacklist.
subfiles.summary: KOKUYO MARU and TONAN MARU Nos. 2 and 3 were reportedly among blacklisted Japanese whaling ships and tankers.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of blacklist report
subfiles.about: Restates the reported British blacklist.
subfiles.summary: Names KOKUYO MARU and TONAN MARU Nos. 2 and 3.

subfiles.title: ARABIA MARU at Bahia
subfiles.about: Reports ARABIA MARU's arrival and departure from Bahia.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Santos June 9 and departed June 12 for Japan via the Canal and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Navy and Coast Guard paraphrase of ARABIA MARU report
subfiles.about: Restates ARABIA MARU's Bahia passage.
subfiles.summary: Reports its June 12 departure for Japan via the Canal and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Kobe bills of health for SAN RAMON and TOSAN
subfiles.about: Reports two Japanese vessels granted bills of health.
subfiles.summary: SAN RAMON was bound for Los Angeles with fuel cargo; TOSAN for New York via Los Angeles and Cristóbal.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of SAN RAMON and TOSAN report
subfiles.about: Restates the two bills of health and routes.
subfiles.summary: Notes SAN RAMON's gasoline and oil cargo.
